summary: Arcus Biosciences filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose the discontinuation of the Phase 3 STAR-121 study due to futility (domvanalimab plus zimberelimab and chemotherapy), as recommended by the IDMC; and that Gilead will not make an option continuation payment, ending its option rights to additional early-stage programs (CCR6, CD89, CD40L) after July 14, 2026. Gilead retains limited options to AB801, AB598, AB102, and a TNF small-molecule inhibitor. Arcus retains full rights to casdatifan except those licensed to Taiho. No financial terms, deal mechanics, or board recommendation were provided. Watch for any restructuring of the Gilead collaboration or potential impact on Arcus's pipeline valuation.
